name: Sentinel
description: Sentinel watches Jellyfin playback sessions and explains, with evidence, why a specific transcode or playback problem happened — not just that it happened.
overview: Evidence-based root-cause diagnosis for Jellyfin playback problems

versions.changelog: Adds full localization (English, German, Spanish, French, Swedish, Danish, Polish) — a per-plugin Language setting, and every diagnosis explanation/recommendation plus every dashboard UI string is now translated at serve time via a new GET Sentinel/ui-strings endpoint. Fixes the dashboard's media display to show "Series - Episode Name" for TV episodes instead of just the episode name. Adds the Incident Engine: diagnoses sharing the same rule code, media item, client, and device are now deduplicated into a single Incident (via a partial unique SQLite index on that fingerprint) instead of alerting once per raw diagnosis; a resolved incident that recurs reopens instead of duplicating; new GET/POST Sentinel/incidents endpoints (list, acknowledge, resolve). The dashboard is rewritten from a plain diagnosis table into a card-based Incident view with status badges, occurrence counts, and working Acknowledge/Resolve buttons, plus a language selector wired to the new setting. Notification Delivery (Webhook/Discord/Telegram/Email), the plugin-update/restart-pending notification feature, and a dedicated security review are NOT yet in this release — tracked for a following one. Verified by a fresh-subagent review after every task (spec compliance + code quality, including independent re-runs of the full test suite and independent JSON-validity checks on all 7 locale files); not yet confirmed against a real Jellyfin server for any of this release's features.

Adds five new diagnosis rules covering external audio tracks, HDR/dynamic-range mismatches, audio channel downmixing, bitrate-only transcodes, and resolution-only transcodes — including the exact real-world case confirmed on a live server in 0.1.4.0 (an AV1 transcode with only an audio-channel-downmix reason, previously unrecognized). Also wires up the previously dormant Known Core Issues table into the API and dashboard, surfaced as a distinct "Known Jellyfin Bug" note. Verified by three rounds of independent review; each rule's PlayMethod == Transcode gate and mutual exclusivity with stronger, more specific diagnoses is covered by a dedicated regression test, verified RED/GREEN by temporarily removing every gate and confirming each one is independently caught. Not yet confirmed against a real server for these specific new rules.

Fixes a data-integrity bug confirmed on a real server running 0.1.3.0: a session with a verified, active ffmpeg transcode (video re-encoded, audio downmixed — confirmed via the server's own transcode log) still produced a PlaybackEvent row with PlayMethod = DirectPlay next to a correctly non-zero TranscodeReasons, silently suppressing the diagnosis despite the reasons having been captured correctly. PlaybackEventFactory now forces PlayMethod to Transcode when TranscodeReasons is non-default and PlayMethod resolved to DirectPlay or null (DirectStream/remux sessions are correctly left alone, since they legitimately carry non-zero TranscodeReasons too — a broader first version of this fix was caught and narrowed during review before release). Verified by two rounds of independent review plus a regression test reproducing the exact real-world contradiction; not yet re-confirmed against a real server for this specific fix.

Fixes a bug affecting every previous version: Jellyfin always clears the play method and transcode-reason data on a session before firing the event this plugin used to read them from, so PlaybackEvent rows were recorded with an empty play method and zero transcode reasons regardless of whether a transcode actually happened — confirmed live with a real bitrate-driven transcode that produced a blank database row despite Jellyfin's own dashboard showing an active transcode with a specific reason. Sentinel now also listens to playback-progress events (while that data is still live) and caches it per playback, including a fallback for Jellyfin's own idle-timeout stop path, which never supplies the identifier this plugin would otherwise key on. Verified by three rounds of independent review plus targeted regression tests reproducing the exact real-world event sequence; not yet re-confirmed against a real server for this specific fix.

Adds a minimal read-only dashboard to the plugin's configuration page: recent diagnoses (media, client/device, confidence, explanation) with click-to-expand evidence, backed by a new admin-only API endpoint. Verified by code inspection, two independent review rounds, and a clean local build/test run; not yet independently confirmed against a real server for this specific feature.

Fixes a confirmed bug in 0.1.0.0: installing on a real Jellyfin server resulted in status 'Malfunctioned' because of native SQLite library loading (see build.yaml changelog for the full root cause). Confirmed loading and running correctly on a real Jellyfin 12.1 server. 0.1.0.0 is removed from this list since it is confirmed broken.
